title: StableNew review gateway sync contract v1
description: Payloads exchanged between the StableNew PC sync worker (RG-120) and the review gateway (RG-110). The PC initiates every exchange. Items are identified by library id plus SHA-256 and never by path (RG-100 invariant 3). Outbox records are requests the PC validates, applies or refuses (invariant 4). A breaking change bumps schema_version.

library_id.description: Opaque, stable Output Library item id assigned by the PC. Never a path.

run_id.description: Output run folder name, used only for grouping.

item_withdrawal.description: PC to gateway (PHONE-FAST): stop showing items published earlier that are not a job's output, such as video frames. Not a decision: an item with a decision or a waiting request is left alone, and nothing is sent to Immich. Sent only to a gateway that lists the item_withdraw feature.

item_source.description: PHONE-FAST: which review section an item belongs to, derived by the PC from its output folder and kind. A category id only; no folder name or path crosses.

item_sources.description: PC to gateway (PHONE-FAST): the review sections of items published before manifests carried one. Sent only to a gateway that lists the item_source feature.

item_batch.description: The named batch (N5 packs x models) the job that made this item was queued in, from its provenance.metadata.batch. Display and grouping only: the phone inbox groups by batch when there is one, and by run_id otherwise. A PC sends it only to a gateway whose health lists the 'item_batch' feature.

cell.description: This item's cell of the batch: the PromptPack name and the checkpoint file name (never a path).

item_manifest.description: PC to gateway: one publishable item. Media bodies are uploaded separately and addressed by their sha256. Idempotent by (library_id, sha256).

parent.description: PHONE-FAST: the item this one is a phone rework of. Sent only to a gateway whose health lists item_parent.

display.description: Display-only text, rendered as text on the phone (S7). Never used for decisions.

favorite.description: Only meaningful with keep; the PC refuses favorite with delete.

action_request.description: RG-140: a phone action, in two steps. 'prepare' asks the PC to compile exactly what it would queue and answer with an action_summary, admitting nothing; 'confirm' names that prepare record and the summary revision the phone showed, and the PC admits only when its fresh compile has the same revision. Validated again on the PC against its closed lists; slice 1 implements fix_face, fix_hands, fix_both and more_like_this, slice 2 another_model, aspect_ratio, prompt_tweak and make_video. rerun_clip and continue_clip stay reserved.

count.description: more_like_this only, on prepare: how many new seeds.

choice.description: another_model and aspect_ratio only, on prepare: one id from the action_choices the PC listed. Without it the PC answers with the list.

text.description: prompt_tweak (required: words added to the prompt) and make_video (optional: the motion prompt) only, on prepare. One line of plain text; the PC scrubs anything it shows back.

action_warning.description: One N1 policy warning as the PC shows it (S12): PC-authored text, scrubbed of paths, rendered as text only.

action_summary.description: PC to gateway, inside an acknowledgement receipt: the one-screen summary of what an action would queue (RG-140). The phone shows it before Queue; 'revision' fingerprints everything shown plus the compiled recipe without ids and seeds.

choice_id.description: An option id the PC made (RG-140 slice 2): a checkpoint's id or an aspect ratio such as 2x3. Never a path.

action_choices.description: PC to gateway, inside an acknowledgement receipt (RG-140 slice 2): what the phone may pick for another_model (the PC's checkpoints) or aspect_ratio. Labels are PC-written and scrubbed of paths; 'current' marks the image's own.

outbox_record.description: Gateway to PC: one phone request. Decisions and action requests name an item target; an admin_request (LAUNCH-UPDATE-2) has none.

outbox_page.description: Gateway to PC, in reply to the PC's list request: pending records in creation order.

enrolled_devices.description: Devices enrolled from pairing offers since the PC's last acknowledgement, so the desktop can list and revoke them.

acknowledgement.description: PC to gateway: the authoritative outcome of one outbox record. The gateway purges nothing before this arrives (S9).

detail.description: Why an action could not be prepared or admitted, as a closed code (never compiler text, which can name paths).

immich_receipt.description: Gateway to PC (listed with the outbox): the result of uploading a kept item to Immich (D3). Idempotent by Immich checksum.

device_revocation.description: PC to gateway: revoke a device enrolled from this desktop (S11). The gateway can also revoke locally.

pairing_offer.description: PC to gateway: a single-use phone enrollment offer (D5, S1). The desktop shows the code; only its salted hash is sent. The gateway enforces expiry and an attempt cap, then reports the enrolled device id in the next outbox page's device list or by refusal. The 'admin' scope (LAUNCH-UPDATE-2, D2) is only ever in an offer the desktop creates for remote update.

commit_sha.description: A full Git commit id of StableNew's repository, lowercase.

deploy_request.description: PC to gateway (DEPLOY-2): deploy this commit of main to the gateway. The gateway only hands the commit id to its root deployer, which checks with GitHub that it is a signed merge on main and newer than the deployed commit. Refused while the console switch is off.

deploy_status.description: Gateway to PC (DEPLOY-2): the console switch, the deployed commit, a request still waiting for the deployer, and the deployer's last result (outcome running while it works).

admin_request.description: LAUNCH-UPDATE-2: a remote update request from a phone holding the 'admin' grant. It names only the origin/main commit the phone was shown (D3); the PC fetches origin itself, refuses 'target_moved' when origin/main is any other commit and runs its own preflight. No ref, path, remote or option comes from it.

update_reason.description: Why a live update did not happen or what it ended as (LAUNCH-UPDATE reason codes).

update_receipt.description: PC to gateway: the outcome of one live update, in an acknowledgement receipt and as the last result in pc_status. Commit ids and closed codes only, never Git or launcher text. 'health' is the updater's start check of the new app: 'unconfirmed' means it was started but did not report in within the wait.

pc_status.description: PC to gateway (LAUNCH-UPDATE-2, D3): the PC's checkout and queue state, so an admin phone can offer 'Update to <sha>'. Commit ids and counts only: no paths, no commit text, no job names. The gateway keeps the latest one and shows it only to devices holding the 'admin' grant.

rating_id.description: A rating task id chosen on the PC (RG-170). Never a path.

rating_task.description: PC to gateway (RG-170): one rating sitting or feedback question. Opaque ids and SHA-256 media only; no paths, file names or arm identities. Sent only to a gateway whose health lists 'rating_tasks'.

rating_submission_page.description: Gateway to PC (RG-170): submitted ratings the PC has not answered yet. Requests the PC validates, applies or refuses.
